title: Caja premium
brief: Second round of the SuiteLocal POS with professional, elegant finish (user feedback: first round looked too basic). Built only with effects Qt/QSS can render: gradients, radii, shadows, SVG icons.

artboards.title: Noir ejecutivo (venta)
artboards.tradeoff: Dark, premium and low eye strain for long shifts, with live KPIs and product art; dark themes need care under bright store lighting

artboards.title: Porcelana (momento de cobro)
artboards.tradeoff: Light, warm and editorial, with split payment, numeric pad and change in one dialog; less dramatic than the dark theme
